text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Washington rejects normalising ties with Iraq before it accounts for 600 missing Kuwaitis believed to be detained in Iraq since the 1990/91 Gulf crisis.
- Kuwait signs accords with Austria and Poland to ban dual taxation and protect investments.
- Kuwait's oil minister tours Kuwait Oil Company facilities and oil fields.

- Kuwait releases six prisoners from a deportation centre after serving two to five-year jail sentences. The prisoners, jailed for cooperating with Iraqi forces during Iraq's seven-month occupation of Kuwait, have no passports.
- Member of parliament Jassem al-Kharafi challenges parliament speaker elections. The challenge to be discussed by the assembly on Tuesday.
- Tehran says it has good relations with Kuwait and Saudi Arabia and does not intend to enter confrontation with the United States.
- Kuwait sees dramatic rise in divorce rate.
- Arab Gulf states step up joint military efforts.
